[/b]
[/size][/color]
[size=4]Description:
[/size]
Ever thought the slime hutch is a bit useless and never ended up getting it? Well if you're a crop person like me this mod is for you! This mod turns the slime hutch into a 14 x 14 custom made greenhouse. For now it doesn't change the exterior but there are plans for it if I'm not lazy. Sadly, I couldn't figure out how to make the slime incubator not spawn inside (if anyone knows it would be great if you could tell me!) so I decided to make an option for the slime incubator to be invisible which will be enabled by default. You can disable it in the config file (it will be generated when you first open the game with the mod) or by using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu mod[/url].  The mod doesn't change the price or ingridients needed for the building. I thought it's fair as it is. This mod also doesn't remove or change the event with Marlon when you get your first one at the moment but I might do some changes to it.

Please let me know if you find any errors or bugs I would really appreciate it!

[size=4]
